summary: OI high and low from a full packet are the day's market state: after later quote and ticker packets, which do not carry them, a 20-level book frame still shows them; a new market connection starts them afresh (R107-12).

notes: The web sends oi_high and oi_low only with a full packet's dict; the desktop keeps them as market state (lead: market-state values overlay and go only on an explicit clear).

deviations.reason: The web sends every Depth holder of an instrument both books, the 5-level one and the 20-level one in turn; the desktop sends each holder only the book at its own depth.
